difficulty_reason: The author proves that a dual tensor functional satisfying analytic P(z)-compatibility and local grading generates a grading-restricted twisted module, then identifies the complete tensor-product space by these conditions. The proof includes equivariance, analytic duality and grading reconstruction; all definitions and source-local support, including the substantial convergence lemma, are retained. This is a characterization of a tensor-space membership criterion, distinct from the preceding operator-transform dualities.
